newsitem.title: PERU: Occidental signs contract for Peru block.
newsitem.headline: Occidental signs contract for Peru block.

text.p: The Peruvian subsidiary of U.S. oil company Occidental Petroleum Corp on Thursday signed a contract with the Peruvian government for the exploration and possible development of oil block 72.
Energy and Mines Ministry sources said company officials indicated after the signing ceremony that they planned to spend $44.5 million in the initial exploration phase.
Block 73 covers 798 million hectares in the departments of Loreto and San Martin in northeastern Peru.
"This is the eighth oil contract that the government has signed so far this year," said a ministry source.

Energy and Mines Minister Alberto Pandolfi said recently that Peru hoped to sign a further six conctracts with private companies to explore and develop hydrocarbon contracts in the rest of 1996 and eight more in 1997.
The government currently has 33 contracts running, 18 for exploration and 15 for extraction.
